mapper.sql: id, username, nickname, avatar, password_hash, status, role, banned, banned_reason, banned_at, review_note, reviewed_at, reviewed_by, invite_code, register_ip, created_at, last_login_at, updated_at

where.if: and (username like concat('%', #{keyword}, '%') or nickname like concat('%', #{keyword}, '%'))

mapper.select: select u.id, u.username, u.nickname, u.avatar, u.password_hash, u.status, u.role, u.banned, u.banned_reason, u.banned_at, u.review_note, u.reviewed_at, u.reviewed_by, u.invite_code, u.register_ip, u.created_at, u.last_login_at, u.updated_at from app_user u inner join app_user_identity i on i.user_id = u.id where i.type = #{type} and i.identifier = #{identifier} limit 1
select id, status, banned, banned_reason, review_note from app_user where id = #{id}
select role from app_user where id = #{id}
mapper.update: update app_user set role = #{role}, updated_at = now() where id = #{id}
mapper.select: select count(*) from app_user where role = #{role}
mapper.insert: insert into app_user (username, nickname, avatar, password_hash, status, invite_code, register_ip) values (#{username}, #{nickname}, #{avatar,jdbcType=LONGVARCHAR}, #{passwordHash,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{status}, #{inviteCode,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{registerIp,jdbcType=VARCHAR})
mapper.update: update app_user set last_login_at = now() where id = #{id}
update app_user set status = #{status}, review_note = #{reviewNote,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, reviewed_at = now(), reviewed_by = #{reviewedBy,jdbcType=BIGINT}, updated_at = now() where id = #{id}
update app_user set password_hash = #{passwordHash}, updated_at = now() where id = #{id}
update app_user set banned = #{banned}, banned_reason = #{bannedReason,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, banned_at = #{bannedAt,jdbcType=TIMESTAMP}, updated_at = now() where id = #{id}
mapper.select: select count(1) as total, ifnull(sum(case when status = 'pending' then 1 else 0 end), 0) as pending, ifnull(sum(case when status = 'approved' and banned = 0 then 1 else 0 end), 0) as approved, ifnull(sum(case when status = 'rejected' then 1 else 0 end), 0) as rejected, ifnull(sum(case when banned = 1 then 1 else 0 end), 0) as banned, ifnull(sum(case when created_at >= curdate() then 1 else 0 end), 0) as newToday, ifnull(sum(case when last_login_at >= date_sub(now(), interval 7 day) then 1 else 0 end), 0) as activeRecently from app_user
select count(1) from information_schema.tables where table_schema = database() and table_name = #{tableName}
select o.user_id as userId, count(f.id) as cnt from media_owner o join media_favorite f on f.owner_key = o.owner_key where o.user_id in #{uid} group by o.user_id
select o.user_id as userId, count(p.id) as cnt from media_owner o join media_playlist p on p.owner_key = o.owner_key where o.user_id in #{uid} group by o.user_id
mapper.update: update media_owner set user_id = null where user_id = #{userId}
